prompt: I just pushed my branch. Create a PR targeting main with the title 'Fix screen recording loop on Android' and tag it with the 'bug' label. Add alice and bob as reviewers. The body should reference issue #540 so it auto-closes when merged.

assertions.text: Uses gh pr create (not gh api or other approach)
assertions.rationale: The built-in command is the idiomatic way to create PRs

assertions.text: Includes --title with the exact title 'Fix screen recording loop on Android'

assertions.rationale: User asked for the bug label
User specifically asked for auto-close on merge — requires GitHub linking keywords

assertions.text: Includes --base main to target the main branch
assertions.rationale: User said 'targeting main' — should be explicit even if main is default

assertions.text: Mentions that 'Closes' or 'Fixes' in the body is what triggers auto-close
assertions.rationale: Educational value — the user should understand why this syntax matters
